# Fence Workshop

Fence Workshop operates two businesses under one brand: a commercial and residential fence installation company serving the Atlanta, Georgia metro area, and a nationwide online shop selling aluminum fencing, driveway gates, and fence kits that ship direct to homeowners and contractors.

> Installation services: Atlanta, GA metro only. Online shop: ships nationwide.

## Commercial Fence Installation (Atlanta, GA)

- [Commercial Fence Installation](https://fenceworkshop.com/installation/georgia/commercial-fence-installation/): Commercial fence installation for warehouses, distribution centers, industrial facilities, HOAs, and commercial properties throughout the Atlanta metro area.
- [Commercial Chain Link Fence](https://fenceworkshop.com/installation/georgia/commercial-chain-link-fence/): Heavy-gauge commercial chain link fence installation for industrial and commercial sites.
- [Commercial Security Fence](https://fenceworkshop.com/installation/georgia/commercial-security-fence/): High-security perimeter fencing for commercial and industrial properties.
- [Security Gate Systems](https://fenceworkshop.com/installation/georgia/security-gate-systems/): Electric gate systems, slide gates, and access control for commercial facilities.
- [Slide Gates](https://fenceworkshop.com/installation/georgia/slide-gates/): Industrial slide gate installation for commercial driveways and warehouse entrances.
- [Dumpster Enclosure Gates](https://fenceworkshop.com/installation/georgia/dumpster-enclosure-gates/): Dumpster enclosure and dumpster gate installation for commercial and multi-family properties.
- [Warehouse Partitions](https://fenceworkshop.com/installation/georgia/warehouse-partitions/): Interior warehouse partitions and security caging for industrial facilities.
- [Parking Garage Fencing](https://fenceworkshop.com/installation/georgia/parking-garage-fencing/): Fencing and barrier systems for parking garages and parking structures.
- [Bollard Installation](https://fenceworkshop.com/installation/georgia/bollard-installation/): Steel bollard installation for storefronts, drive-throughs, and vehicle barrier applications.
- [Bollard Replacement](https://fenceworkshop.com/installation/georgia/bollard-replacement/): Damaged or broken bollard removal and replacement.

## Online Fence Shop (Ships Nationwide)

- [Aluminum Driveway Gates](https://fenceworkshop.com/shop/driveway-gates/): Aluminum double-swing driveway gate kits in standard widths from 8ft to 16ft. Wrought iron style, black, TGIC powder coated, American-made. Kits start at $985.16.
- [Aluminum Fencing & Fence Panels](https://fenceworkshop.com/shop/aluminum-fencing/): Residential aluminum fence panels at wholesale pricing. American-made 6063-T5 aluminum in black, bronze, and white. Multiple styles and heights. Panels start at $80.35.
- [Aluminum Fence Kits](https://fenceworkshop.com/shop/fence-kits/): Complete DIY aluminum fence kits — panels, posts, walk gate, and hardware sized to your total footage. Pool fence kits available. Kits start at $2,693.59.
- [Walk Gates](https://fenceworkshop.com/shop/walk-gates/): Self-closing aluminum walk gate kits with spring hinges and gravity latch. Pool code ready with MagnaLatch upgrade.
- [Fence Posts](https://fenceworkshop.com/shop/fence-posts/): Aluminum fence posts in every type — line, corner, end, T-post, and gate posts. Color-matched in black, bronze, and white.
- [Gate Hardware & Accessories](https://fenceworkshop.com/shop/accessories/): Gate hinges, gate latches, MagnaLatch pool gate latches, post caps, deck mounts, and fence hardware.
- [Chain Link Fencing](https://fenceworkshop.com/shop/chain-link-fencing/): Black vinyl coated and galvanized chain link fence. Pricing by quote — call (404) 314-4419.
- [Vinyl Fencing](https://fenceworkshop.com/shop/vinyl-fencing/): White vinyl fence, vinyl privacy fence, and vinyl picket fence. Pricing by quote.
